CUSTOMER : OMERTSUC :: ATHLETIC : ? :: DOMESTIC : STICEMOD
questions.solution_en:
CUSTOMER : OMERTSUC :: DOMESTIC : STICEMOD

Here, the pattern is:

The 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th letters from left end are written at the start then the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th letters in reverse order i.e., 4th, 3rd, 2nd and 1st letters.

Thus, in ATHLETIC -

The 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th letters from left end are written at the start = ETIC

Then, the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th letters in reverse order i.e., 4th, 3rd, 2nd and 1st letters = LHTA

So, ATHLETIC = ETICLHTA
